title: He Paid 10,000 Bitcoin for Two Pizzas #shorts
description:
On May 22, 2010, programmer Laszlo Hanyecz paid 10,000 bitcoin for two Papa John's pizzas, widely described as the first known real-world purchase made with bitcoin. The pizzas cost about $41 at the time. Fortune/AP put the value of those coins at roughly $1.1 billion in May 2025. A true story.

Question: what would you have bought with 10,000 bitcoin? Tell me in the comments.

Made with AI assistance (research, voice and artwork). Events are simplified for storytelling.
